# Cross-straddle REQUIRES list is generated by spangap-inside at staging time
# (../staging/main_requires.cmake) from straddle.yaml's requires: / optional_requires:
# intersected with the staged set. The --no-lcd / --no-web / --without flags
# narrow that set; everything else falls out automatically.
#
# Path uses CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR (not CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR) — in IDF's component-
# requirements pre-pass, CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR resolves to the build dir, not the
# project source dir, so the include fails. CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR is the dir
# of this file and is stable across both passes.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../staging/main_requires.cmake")

# Generated entry point: app_main() + the start/init dispatchers
# (spangapStartStraddles / spangapInitStraddles) — spangap-inside writes it into
# staging/ from the staged straddles' start:/init: declarations. This IS the
# whole main; there is no main.cpp. Guard on EXISTS so a raw idf.py invocation
# without staging still configures (the spangap build path always writes it
# before idf.py; a raw idf.py build would then simply have no app_main to link).
set(_INIT_DISPATCH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../staging/spangap_init_dispatch.gen.cpp")
if(NOT EXISTS "${_INIT_DISPATCH}")
    set(_INIT_DISPATCH "")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "tdeck.cpp"
        "gps.cpp"
        "rtc.cpp"
        ${_INIT_DISPATCH}
        # conditional/<name>/ board code, compiled only when <name> is staged
        # (tdeck_lcd.cpp under conditional/spangap-lcd/).
        ${SPANGAP_CONDITIONAL_SRCS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "." ${SPANGAP_CONDITIONAL_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    REQUIRES
        ${SPANGAP_REQUIRES}
        # ESP-IDF / managed components stay static — not gateable straddles.
        driver
        esp_event
        esp_netif
        esp_wifi
        lwip
)
